decision: The dataset and current sim agree under the intended closed-loop expert control. Retract the severe-OOD conclusion. Do not collect force data for scale. Keep the V2 train-only normalizer and report eval-time saturation as a policy monitor. Training on the dataset is allowed on force grounds; the actual retrain decision is governed by the gripper fix and the user's new-run plan.
